description: With train.admit_mode verdict, self-hosting admission of a PR that changes the toolchain set (D-079, TRAIN-ADMIT-GATE-CHANGE): on (default) admits a verdict whose only difference from the strict rule is the head's own toolchain_id on a dual verdict, the pinned gate's cold gate.passed of the head on the tip and the head's own tooling run cold on the same head (train.self_host_command) both green; off refuses every foreign toolchain_id as before (the rollback). Changed only through scripts/config set --reason.
